name: How long does a bathroom vanity upgrade project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom vanity upgrade project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom vanity upgrade project depends on its complexity. A simple like-for-like replacement of a pre-fabricated vanity can often be completed within one to two days, assuming no major plumbing or structural changes are needed. If the project involves custom cabinetry, extensive plumbing relocation, new flooring, or wall modifications, it can extend to several days or even over a week. Lead times for custom vanity orders can also add to the overall project timeline, so planning ahead is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple vanity replacement can take 1-2 days, while more complex projects with custom work or plumbing changes may take over a week.
